title_zh: 我市深入实施交通先行战略 织密城乡交通网匠心铺就幸福路
title_en: Lhasa Advances Transport-First Strategy to Weave a Dense Urban-Rural Transport Network
summary_zh: 拉萨市深入实施交通先行战略，持续完善城乡交通网络布局，以交通基础设施建设提升群众出行条件与幸福感。
summary_en: Lhasa is deepening its transport-first strategy, steadily improving urban and rural transport networks and upgrading infrastructure to improve residents' travel conditions and well-being.
